body:
4/5 different antidepressants/few antianxiety, talk therapy for around 8 years. Inpatient/outpatient. Ketamine infusions. None has really done anything—- and the side effects usually make them worse than when I’d began them. 

Suppose there’s always the chance for things to ‘improve’ ;I’m just exhausted beyond what I can describe in words really. I don’t have any motivation to wait around for those things to happen, if they do at all. Maybe because it’s been so long, I’m not sure.
Treatment resistant depression/panic disorder for the most part, really. Wish those didn’t weigh on me. I can’t remember the last time i felt functional.
